entry.title: Boomerang: Bitcoin Cold Storage with Built-In Coercion Resistance
entry.summary: The significance of incorporating a recovery plan alongside the protection strategy in systems designed for long-term savings cannot be overstated. It is crucial to consider scenarios where trusted individuals might lose their devices or when supporting services may become unavailable in the future. To mitigate these risks effectively, implementing a straightforward recovery checklist is advisable. This checklist should outline the steps needed to retrieve access or data under various potential loss conditions. Additionally, it would be beneficial to recommend that users practice these recovery procedures with small amounts initially to ensure familiarity and preparedness for any unforeseen circumstances. This approach not only secures the system more robustly but also instills confidence in its users, promoting a more resilient saving environment.
